policy: Select tools after engine and format discovery. Pin the chosen version and prove a no-change round trip. Local LLM and machine-translation tools are prohibited; local OCR/STT requires explicit current-task authorization.

profiles.core: Portable inspection, hashing, archives, and project scripts
profiles.qa: CAT/TMX/PO conversion and automated localization checks
profiles.fonts: Arabic glyph coverage, shaping, BiDi, and font engineering
profiles.media: Images, subtitles, audio, and visual evidence
profiles.ocr: Text baked into images when asset extraction is insufficient
profiles.patching: Binary delta release packages; never a substitute for verified rebuilds
profiles.binary: Read-only binary format inspection and schema experiments
profiles.source: Source-engine archive inspection and version-specific localization
profiles.gamemaker: GameMaker data.win inspection and version-specific localization
profiles.unreal: Unreal Engine archives, IoStore, LocRes, and cooked assets
profiles.unity: Unity bundles/assets and runtime localization hooks
profiles.age-of-empires: Age of Empires II DE/HD strings and font atlases
profiles.stardew: Stardew Valley custom languages, content packs, and bitmap fonts
profiles.rimworld: RimWorld language mods and runtime text patches
profiles.rpg-maker: RPG Maker archives, Ruby Marshal data, and translation editors
profiles.monogame: MonoGame/XNA/FNA .NET games: decompiling, XNB, runtime layers
profiles.scumm: SCUMM Special Edition, classic, and ScummVM games
profiles.telltale: Telltale Tool archives and language databases
profiles.dinky: Dinky/GGPack games (Return to Monkey Island, Thimbleweed Park)
profiles.proprietary-pc: Custom PC engines and console ports
profiles.android: Android APK unpacking, alignment, signing, and logs
profiles.ps1: PlayStation 1 disc images in an emulator
profiles.ps2: PlayStation 2 disc images in an emulator

tools.name: Python
tools.note: Runs the deterministic project scripts.

tools.name: Git
tools.note: Versioning for project-owned text and scripts; never commit copyrighted game assets.

tools.name: 7-Zip / 7zr
tools.note: Portable general archive inspection; not an engine-specific repacker.

tools.name: fontTools/TTX
tools.note: Coverage, tables, merge, subset, and deterministic font inspection.

tools.name: HarfBuzz
tools.note: Reference shaping tests; does not prove the game renderer uses HarfBuzz.

tools.name: GNU FriBidi
tools.note: Reference Unicode BiDi conversion and diagnostics.

tools.name: Translate Toolkit
tools.note: PO/XLIFF/TMX conversion, counts, conflicts, terminology, and 40+ pofilter checks.

tools.name: Okapi Framework
tools.note: Filters, extraction/merge, pseudo-localization, and format QA.

tools.name: LanguageTool
tools.note: Proofreading only after measuring Arabic false positives on the game's names and tone.

tools.name: ImageMagick
tools.note: Batch image conversion, compositing, dimensions, and visual-diff preparation.

tools.name: OpenCV
tools.note: Deterministic masks, geometry, compositing, and small flat-region inpainting. Telea/Navier-Stokes are not reliable background restoration for complex artwork.

tools.name: PaddleOCR
tools.note: Candidate text detection only after explicit current-task local OCR authorization. Use alpha-aware previews/upscaling and visually reject false positives.

tools.name: IOPaint / LaMa
tools.note: Local restoration candidate with a tight mask and residual-text retry loop. Repository archived in 2025; keep the backend replaceable and obtain model-install authority first.

tools.name: SAM2
tools.note: Segments the containing object or surface; intersect with text evidence rather than treating it as OCR. Model download/use requires the applicable project authority.

tools.name: DirectXTex texconv
tools.note: DDS format, mip, compression, and alpha round-trip tooling. Block compression is lossy; reproduce the source settings instead of forcing BC7.

tools.name: FFmpeg
tools.note: Audio/video/subtitle extraction and conversion.

tools.name: Tesseract OCR
tools.note: Local OCR candidate generation only after explicit current-task user authorization; manually verify every accepted string.

tools.name: whisper.cpp
tools.note: Local speech recognition only after explicit current-task user authorization; timestamps and names need review.

tools.name: Xdelta3
tools.note: Small binary delta packages tied to an exact original checksum.

tools.name: HDiffPatch
tools.note: Fast file/directory deltas; ship checksum verification and restoration instructions.

tools.name: FModel
tools.note: Read-oriented Unreal archive discovery/export; not a universal writer.

tools.name: repak
tools.note: Deterministic-capable .pak CLI; writing compression/encryption support is limited.

tools.name: retoc
tools.note: IoStore .utoc/.ucas workflows; version compatibility must be proven.

tools.name: UAssetGUI/UAssetAPI
tools.note: Inspect/edit supported cooked assets with explicit engine version and mappings.

tools.name: UassetLocalize
tools.note: CSV/PO localization for supported .uasset/.umap/.locres; round-trip first.

tools.name: UnrealLocres
tools.note: Export and import .locres string tables to CSV; confirm the LocRes version for the exact engine build.

tools.name: RE-UE4SS
tools.note: Runtime research and override only, after protection checks and the user's approval; never the default localization route.

tools.name: UnityPy
tools.note: Scriptable extraction and editing for supported Unity assets.

tools.name: UABEA
tools.note: Interactive Unity asset/bundle inspection and supported edits.

tools.name: AssetRipper
tools.note: Broad project reconstruction and analysis; often heavier than a small patch route.

tools.name: BepInEx
tools.note: Runtime plugin framework; match Mono/IL2CPP and game version before use.

tools.name: XUnity.AutoTranslator
tools.note: Runtime capture/prototyping and font overrides. Keep it external unless there is a reviewed reason to incorporate MIT code and preserve its notice.

tools.name: UnityDoorstop
tools.note: Separate runtime loader for Unity Mono/IL2CPP. Injection requires per-game approval and an anti-cheat/protection check.

tools.name: AssetsTools.NET
tools.note: Read/write library for supported Unity assets and bundles. Pin a tested version and preserve the MIT notice if redistributed.

tools.name: Cpp2IL / LibCpp2IL
tools.note: IL2CPP metadata and analysis candidate. Work-in-progress; use for lawful inspection only and stop on protected/encrypted metadata.

tools.name: RTLTMPro
tools.note: Source-level Unity TextMesh Pro RTL support.

tools.name: GodotPCKExplorer
tools.note: PCK inspection/repack fallback; prefer Godot's native localization when sources exist.

tools.name: unrpyc
tools.note: Decompile .rpyc for inspection when lawful and needed.

tools.name: rpatool
tools.note: List/extract/create Ren'Py RPA archives.

tools.name: VNTranslationTools
tools.note: Excel-based extract/reinsert workflow for supported VN engines.

tools.name: GARbro
tools.note: Broad VN archive discovery/extraction; often read-oriented.

tools.name: Danganronpa Another Tool
tools.note: Fallback/comparison only when a proven game-specific pipeline is not stronger.

tools.name: vn-tools Danganronpa Tools
tools.note: Archived reference tools: wad_archiver, pak_archiver, and lin_compiler. Pin and prove a no-change round trip on copies.

tools.name: Spiral Framework
tools.note: Kotlin Danganronpa framework and detailed WAD/PAK/LIN/CPK format reference; test build and round trip before use.

tools.name: HLMWadExplorer
tools.note: AGAR-family WAD inspection/editing candidate; never edit the only original and verify rebuilt structure.

tools.name: HyoutaTools
tools.note: Multi-game extraction/reinsertion collection credited by Spiral for PAK/LIN research; identify the exact module and version first.

tools.name: ImHex
tools.note: Hex editor and pattern language for format discovery; use read-only copies.

tools.name: Kaitai Struct
tools.note: Declarative binary format descriptions and generated parsers.

tools.name: VPKEdit
tools.note: Source VPK inspection and editing candidate; test version-specific round trips.

tools.name: ValveResourceFormat / Source 2 Viewer
tools.note: Source 2 resource and VPK inspection and export; verify write support before relying on it.

tools.name: UndertaleModTool
tools.note: GameMaker data.win inspection candidate; never assume every GameMaker build is compatible.

tools.name: msdf-atlas-gen
tools.note: Multi-channel signed-distance-field atlas generation for Arabic-capable fonts.

tools.name: Subtitle Edit
tools.note: Subtitle timing, format conversion and visual review.

tools.name: pysubs2
tools.note: Deterministic subtitle parsing and writing.

tools.name: GNU gettext
tools.note: PO/MO validation and msgfmt checks.

tools.name: AoE2 DE Custom Font Generator
tools.note: Windows GUI that builds the DE in-game font atlases (.dds/.box) from chosen typefaces and charsets; needs DirectXTex texconv. Write into a mod, not over resources/_common/fonts; the main menu fonts are separate.

tools.name: genie-rs
tools.note: Rust libraries reading Age of Empires I/II formats (including HD language files). Use as an external tool only; do not copy GPL code into the template.

tools.name: SMAPI
tools.note: Stardew Valley mod loader the player installs; writes ErrorLogs/SMAPI-latest.txt (read by boot_verdict.py).

tools.name: Content Patcher
tools.note: SMAPI mod that applies JSON content packs: adds the Data/AdditionalLanguages entry, the font, and the text patches without repacking game files.

tools.name: StardewXnbHack
tools.note: One-way XNB unpacker for reading source text and fonts; never used to repack.

tools.name: AngelCode BMFont
tools.note: Windows bitmap font generator producing text .fnt plus page images from a TTF; include the Arabic presentation forms the build uses.

tools.name: Harmony (Lib.Harmony)
tools.note: Runtime method patching for .NET/Mono games; RimWorld mods ship it. Only for an approved runtime RTL route; never bypass protection.

tools.name: ILSpy command line
tools.note: Read-only .NET decompiler (ilspycmd -p -o out game.dll) to find text, font, and drawing code.

tools.name: Mono.Cecil
tools.note: Rewrites .NET assemblies (inserting calls); keeps MVID and type tokens. Runtime code or decryption: only under 'Protected archives and runtime code' (references/extraction-integration.md).

tools.name: python-lz4
tools.note: LZ4 for compressed XNB files.

tools.name: ScummTR / ScummRP
tools.note: Classic SCUMM text export/import recomputing sizes and jumps; ScummRP replaces CHAR resources. No SCUMM V8.

tools.name: ScummVM
tools.note: Runs SCUMM V8 and GrimE games; its source at the shipped tag is the format reference. External program only.

tools.name: MISETranslator
tools.note: Reads Monkey Island Special Edition text formats; reference for formats, do not copy code.

tools.name: ScummVM tools
tools.note: Extraction and compression tools for ScummVM games, including GrimE resources. External program only.

tools.name: TTG-Tools
tools.note: Telltale archives, langdb, fonts, and textures. Runtime code or decryption: only under 'Protected archives and runtime code' (references/extraction-integration.md).

tools.name: telltale-explorer
tools.note: Telltale archive browser; reference for formats.

tools.name: Dinky-Explorer (Thimbleweed Park Explorer)
tools.note: Browses ggpack archives; keys come from the user's executable and are never published. Runtime code or decryption: only under 'Protected archives and runtime code' (references/extraction-integration.md).

tools.name: ISPC Texture Compressor
tools.note: BC7/BC3 encoding of changed blocks only (archived upstream; pin the last release).

tools.name: DirectXTK (SpriteFont format)
tools.note: Reference for DXTKfont SpriteFont files used by D3D11 ports; set a default character so a missing glyph cannot abort the game.

tools.name: Apktool
tools.note: Decodes and rebuilds APK resources; plain ZIP is enough when only assets change.

tools.name: Android SDK build-tools (zipalign, apksigner)
tools.note: zipalign -p 16 and apksigner v1+v2+v3 with a key the user keeps.

tools.name: Android SDK platform-tools (adb)
tools.note: adb install and adb logcat for device logs (boot_verdict.py --log).

tools.name: DuckStation
tools.note: PS1 emulator with a GDB stub for watchpoints; external program only, never redistributed. The user supplies their own BIOS and disc dump.

tools.name: pycdlib
tools.note: Reads and writes ISO9660 images by sector.

tools.name: PCSX2 (with PINE)
tools.note: PS2 emulator; PINE IPC for snapshots and memory; separate test install; user supplies BIOS and dump.

tools.name: mymcplus
tools.note: PS2 memory card images for test saves (archived upstream).

tools.name: Capstone
tools.note: Disassembler (MIPS R5900 with skipdata) to find drawing routines. Runtime code or decryption: only under 'Protected archives and runtime code' (references/extraction-integration.md).

tools.name: RPGMakerDecrypter
tools.note: Decrypts RPG Maker XP/VX/VX Ace archives and MV/MZ assets. Runtime code or decryption: only under 'Protected archives and runtime code' (references/extraction-integration.md).

tools.name: RubyMarshal (Python)
tools.note: Reads Ruby Marshal data (.rxdata/.rvdata2); write with real Ruby, its writer breaks shared objects.

tools.name: mkxp-z
tools.note: Open RGSS runtime; runs and tests XP/VX/VX Ace games and gives a Ruby for writing Marshal data. External program only.

tools.name: Translator++
tools.note: GUI extraction/reinsertion for RPG Maker and other engines; no Arabic rendering of its own; never its machine-translation features.

tools.name: python-bidi
tools.note: Reference BiDi order for tests (get_display with base_dir='R'); not used in builds.

tools.name: uharfbuzz
tools.note: HarfBuzz from Python for drawing titles and images; shape Arabic and Latin runs separately.

tools.name: freetype-py
tools.note: FreeType rasterizing with uharfbuzz for high-quality image text.

tools.name: python-arabic-reshaper
tools.note: Independent shaping reference for tests only; disable its ligatures (it adds U+FDF2) and note it drops diacritics.

tools.name: texture2ddecoder
tools.note: Decodes BC/DXT/ETC/ASTC textures for review.

tools.name: etcpak (Python)
tools.note: Encodes DXT/ETC textures; refuse silent resizing.

tools.name: python-zstandard
tools.note: Zstandard for compressed emulator states and some game archives.
